verdict.rationale: Telemetry opt-out is a fair question for a cloud platform with a console, APIs and tooling, so the axis applies. The pack never documents any way to disable telemetry or usage tracking. The 'telemetry' mention refers to customer-facing monitoring dashboards, and the usage items describe billing visibility; neither is an opt-out control.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
